name: select unscoped for all staff (read set always true)
find: EXECUTE format('CREATE POLICY %I ON public.%I FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (%s)', 'd0c_' || t || '_select', t, rd);
replace: EXECUTE format('CREATE POLICY %I ON public.%I FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (%s)', 'd0c_' || t || '_select', t, 'true');

name: INSERT open to any reader
find: FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (%s)', 'd0c_' || t || '_insert', t, adm);
replace: FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (%s)', 'd0c_' || t || '_insert', t, rd);

name: UPDATE open to any reader
find: USING (%s) WITH CHECK (%s)', 'd0c_' || t || '_update', t, adm, adm);
replace: USING (%s) WITH CHECK (%s)', 'd0c_' || t || '_update', t, rd, rd);

name: UPDATE WITH CHECK dropped to rd
find: USING (%s) WITH CHECK (%s)', 'd0c_' || t || '_update', t, adm, adm);
replace: USING (%s) WITH CHECK (%s)', 'd0c_' || t || '_update', t, adm, 'true');

name: DELETE open to any reader
find: FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (%s)', 'd0c_' || t || '_delete', t, adm);
replace: FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (%s)', 'd0c_' || t || '_delete', t, rd);

name: AP insert uses wrong atom (any reader)
AP update loses status=approved in USING
AP update loses status=approved in WITH CHECK
notification_types readable by anyone authenticated with no staff check
legacy full-access policy not dropped
find: EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "authenticated users full access" ON public.%I', t);

name: notif_types_read not dropped
find: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS notif_types_read ON public.notification_types;
